newsitem.title: USA: Oakwood sees multi-section strength, weak SW.
newsitem.headline: Oakwood sees multi-section strength, weak SW.

text.p: Oakwood Homes Corp said on Tuesday it saw continued strength in the multi-section homes market but that its southwest retail business was hurt by excessive delivery times and capacity limitations.

"We believe our retail business in the southwest has been adversely affected by excessive delivery lead times and insufficient breadth of multi-section product offerings, each of which was exacerbated by limitations on our multi- section production capacity in the southwest," Nicholas St. George, president and chief executive officer, said.
